//overrides: Security overrides. Each entry pins a transitive dependency that its own
parent still resolves to a vulnerable version — the parent is pinned, so a
version bump of the direct dependency cannot clear it. Remove an entry
once the parent ships the patched range on its own.
Audited by .github/workflows/security-audit.yml; anything here that is NOT
overridable is listed with a justification under //auditConfig below.
GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5 (#157). body-parser comes in through express 4 (backend)
monaco-editor and posthog-js under @scalar (docs). zod 3 never got the fix
(3.25.76 is the last 3.x), so every consumer moves to zod 4: the direct deps
were bumped and this entry keeps SDK and docs transitives (openai,
@anthropic-ai/sdk, zod-to-json-schema, @scalar, nextra) on the patched line.
//auditConfig: Audit allowlist: advisories that genuinely cannot be fixed. Read by
`pnpm audit` in .github/workflows/security-audit.yml. Each entry needs a
verified justification and a re-check date, and is removed as soon as a fix ships.
GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm (braces <=3.0.3, stack-exhaustion DoS on deeply nested
brace patterns). Accepted 2026-10-04; upstream will not fix: the maintainer
rejects the CVE (micromatch/braces#70, comment 5995348316) because it needs
attacker-controlled glob patterns and maxLength already bounds it; the fix
PRs (#72 and later) were closed or left unmerged. Build-time only: every
path is glob/watch tooling (chokidar under @sentry/webpack-plugin, loaded by
webpack during `next build`, not by withSentryConfig at `next start`, verified
via require.cache; tailwindcss; nextra and @scalar in the docs site). No
runtime code imports braces, micromatch, chokidar or fast-glob, and the
patterns it parses come from build config, never from request data. If a
feature ever accepts user-supplied glob patterns, cap maxLength and nesting
depth there ourselves. Re-check 2027-04-04, or sooner if any of these enters
a runtime path; remove the entry if braces >=3.0.4 is ever published.
//patchedDependencies: strips children before parsing; zod 4.3.6 let the missing key through, the
patched zod (>=4.6.6, see //overrides) does not, so every docs page 500s.
The patch marks it optional. Drop it once nextra-theme-docs fixes the schema.
The Dockerfiles copy patches/ before `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`.
